expanded91_late_observational.interpretation: Late expanded observational analysis, not a new confirmatory sample or independent replication. Original and expanded cohorts overlap; facts within a domain share other-fact comparators. Fact bootstrap intervals and sign-flip p-values therefore have limited independence justification. The exact within-domain label permutation is conditional on exchangeability of factual pairing, not a randomized causal test or a control for wording and answer-token confounds. Secondary comparisons are exploratory; repeated feature subsamples are not new independent facts.
